newsitem.title: UK: Blue Circle to pay 164 mln stg for St Marys.
newsitem.headline: Blue Circle to pay 164 mln stg for St Marys.

text.p: Blue Circle Industries Plc, the UK building materials group, said on Monday it would pay 164 million stg for the acquisition of St Marys Cement Corporation of Canada.

The terms of the deal were first unveiled on January 21. The acquisition is expected to be completed in April, it said in a press statement. The sum will be paid in cash and Blue Circle will take on net debt of around 30 million.

St Marys is a building materials company with net assets of 127 million stg and it made operating profits of 29 million in 1996. Its sales volumes for last year were 2.44 million tons of cement and 5.9 million tons of aggregates.
